overall_summary: Historical data shows a very small sample size with overall low view counts across the board. However, topics touching on 'self respect' and modern mobile interaction micro-moments (like chat deletions or saving unnamed numbers) show slight relative outperformance compared to generic emotional venting.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत और खुद की इज्जत' (AfaLxMy6FMY) and 'बिना नाम का नंबर' (aNR94Xxn0yM) achieved the highest views (36 and 24 respectively) in the dataset.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on tangible smartphone boundary-setting behaviors rather than abstract sadness.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract atmospheric hooks without a concrete action
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'इमरजेंसी कॉन्टैक्ट से उसका नंबर हटाया' (hrjJ-QS9M8w) and 'नंबर ब्लॉक नहीं किया कभी' (aUuNKfe7jm4) underperformed significantly with very low view counts (3 and 5).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive longing hooks; tie the emotional state to an immediate decision or physical action.
